newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks rebound on new accounts buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks rebound on new accounts buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose at midday on Thursday after dropping in early trade amid new accounts buying in select blue chips, dealers said.
"Floor sentiment is mixed but major players have taken fresh positions in some of the blue chips available at attractive prices," dealer Shakeel Anwar said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 6.93 points 0.44 percent, to 1,574.43 at 0702 GMT. Losers led gainers 107 to 64.
PTCL (A) fell 0.40 rupees 30.45 rupees. Hub Power rose 0.40 to 40.75.
